result: Current Save flow has PUT /api/settings. The most likely Bad Request is ServerSettingsValidator returning ValidationProblem (400) for invalid numeric/map values, while App.tsx only displays error/detail and hides the response errors dictionary, so the user sees only generic Bad Request. Empty numeric inputs become 0; this can violate settler size, cooldown, cliff interval, or min/max constraints. The Settings UI lacked several persisted server controls and ServerSupervisor hardcoded their values.

evidence.outcome: API error handling dropped ValidationProblem.errors and numeric inputs converted empty values to 0.
PUT /api/settings returns ValidationProblem for invalid settings and conflict when running.
ServerSettings includes autosave slots, LAN visibility, returning-player limit bypass, command mode, and tags.
server-settings.json previously hardcoded several persisted settings.

blockers: No focused API integration regression test exists yet.
